listing.name: Bayonetta 2 (B2recomp)
listing.summary: An experimental Bayonetta 2 static recompilation. Its Builder ZIP contains tools, source and a compiler rather than a prebuilt game; it generates C and a game DLL locally, with rebuilding through the project’s Builder for updates. Windows x64 requires Vulkan 1.3; Linux Builder testing is separate. Use your own Bayonetta 2 v1.2/update v131072 already-decrypted ExeFS/RomFS. Encrypted packages and keys are refused. Portcove offers no setup or launch integration and has not tested gameplay.
